title: Continuous-time learning of probability distributions: a case study in a digital trial of young children with type 1 diabetes
abstract: arXiv:2603.24427v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding how biomarker distributions evolve over time is a central challenge in digital health and chronic disease monitoring. For example, in diabetes, changes in the distribution of glucose measurements can reveal patterns of disease progression and treatment response that conventional summary measures miss. Motivated by a 13-week clinical trial comparing the closed-loop insulin delivery system t:slim X2 with standard therapy in children with type 1 diabetes, we propose a probabilistic framework to model the continuous-time evolution of time-indexed distributions using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) data collected every five minutes. We represent the glucose distribution as a Gaussian mixture, with time-varying mixture weights governed by a neural ODE. translated_title: 概率分布的连续时间学习：1型糖尿病幼儿数字试验中的案例研究
translated_abstract: 理解生物标志物分布如何随时间演变是数字健康和慢性病监测中的核心挑战。例如在糖尿病中，血糖测量值分布的变化可以揭示传统汇总指标所忽略的疾病进展与治疗反应模式。受一项为期13周、比较闭环胰岛素输注系统 t:slim X2 与标准疗法在1型糖尿病儿童中疗效的临床试验启发，我们提出了一个概率框架，利用每五分钟采集一次的连续血糖监测（CGM）数据来建模时间索引分布的连续时间演变。我们将血糖分布表示为高斯混合模型，其时变的混合权重由神经常微分方程（neural ODE）控制，并基于最大均值差异（MMD）的分布匹配准则来估计模型参数。由此得到的框架具有可解释性和计算高效性。
tldr: 提出一个基于高斯混合模型与神经常微分方程的连续时间概率分布学习框架，用于刻画1型糖尿病儿童连续血糖监测数据中血糖分布随时间的动态演变。
